name: Tactics Board
description: Pick a formation, drag your players, add the opponent and draw passes and runs on a football pitch.
prompt: A football tactics board with formations like 4-4-2, 4-3-3, 3-5-2 and 7-a-side, draggable numbered players and ball, an optional opponent, arrows for passes and dashed lines for runs, undo, and saving the board as an image.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Elige una formación, arrastra a tus jugadores, añade al rival y dibuja pases y desmarques en un campo de fútbol.
